capability.title: OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding

capability.summary: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. capability.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling

capability.summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate differential diagnoses for complex cases, but a useful second opinion must also be factually grounded, clinically coherent, actionable, and safe. We developed a multidimensional benchmark using 300 diagnostically resolved NEJM--MedQA cases: 110 for physician reference ratings and Judge calibration and 190 for held-out evaluation. capability.title: AI Consilium: a Benchmark of LLM Clinical Multidisciplinary Second Opinions

capability.summary: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique
capability.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling

capability.summary: Personalization is essential for general-purpose robots to transition into household environments and achieve true practicality. While general robotic manipulation has been extensively studied, personalized robotic manipulation (PeRM) lacks a controlled benchmark for separating task completion from preference satisfaction. capability.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation

capability.title: SEAR: Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics

capability.summary: Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. capability.title: The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement

Task-agnostic play provides broader experience of contact dynamics without specifying task goals. embodiment.title: ForceWAM: Decoupling Future and Response Learning from Demo and Play Data for Contact-Rich Manipulation

embodiment.title: Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning for Path-Safe Target Reaching in Robotic Harvesting of Hydroponic Lettuce
